verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents AI-powered Anomaly Detection that generates insights on transaction monitoring, which is a form of AI-generated insight from data, and its MCP server lets AI agents act on Sumsub data. However, there's no evidence of broader AI-generated suggestions (e.g., dashboards, natural-language insights, recommendations) across the core verification/analytics product beyond this single anomaly-detection feature. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-generated suggestions/insights in the main dashboard or analytics UI, independent corroboration of the anomaly detection's AI insight quality, and broader coverage beyond transaction monitoring.
